profile.headline: Software Engineer Intern
profile.summary: A former instructor who served for two years as a public servant, teaching integrated math, college-level chemistry, and business design. Leveraging experience in data consideration, business applications, and design thinking, transitioned to biotech for data analysis practice and is now pursuing a degree in computer science.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Contribute to Maxun, an open-source website scrapper application
•Lead a team of 3 to implement a feature that allows CSV and XLSX file parsing for document extraction
•Designed and documented an architectural proposal of the feature implementation: 
https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/issues/1109#issuecomment-4938541153
•Modify React component to reflect the changes in the upload document feature

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer Volunteer Intern | Volunteer Service Internship
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented relational database schemas for a time tracking system using Django models, defining structured entities for projects, tasks, and time entries.
• Built and maintained backend services using Django, including RESTful API endpoints for time entry creation, retrieval, and reporting
• Integrated frontend React/TypeScript application with backend APIs to display dynamic dashboards, tables, and aggregated time-based analytics
• Debugged full-stack issues across database, API, and UI layers, resolving inconsistencies in data transformation
• Served as company's GitLab administrator to oversee team's version control workflows including branching strategies and merge request processes

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed to Dagster, an open-source data orchestration software project that aims to manage data pipeline workflow
• Diagnosed and resolved a runtime error in Dagster data pipeline infrastructure where the gRPC server failed to access run storage when deployed through Docker
• Identified root cause as a SQLite concurrent access limitation between the local Dagster orchestrator and an isolated Docker container. Replaced it with a PostgreSQL storage backend to support concurrent multiprocess access
• Configured dagster.yaml file to replace the default SQLite storage backend with PostgreSQL for reliable shared storage across isolated environments
• Documented and shared the solution on GitHub to assist other developers facing the development setup issue: github.com/dagster-io/dagster/issues/32031
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering · Databases · Database Design · Database Development · Docker · Software Industry

positions.title: Cell Line Developer Associate
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Practice aseptic techniques for cell-line development work
• Thaw cell line from cryogenic freezer to establish mini-pools 
• Check health and passage mini-pools throughout the cells' development cycle.
• Establish single cell clone line for monoclonal antibody production
• Operate and monitor gas analyzer
• Operate and monitor cell viability analyzer
• Operate cell metric imaging

positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: College-level Chemistry and Forensic Instructor
positions.description:
Taught as an AP chemistry and forensic instructor. Mentored and offered advices to various groups of secondary students on product development proposals on a volunteer-basis. Roles and volunteer work included:

• Acclimating secondary students to the rigor of university-level workload and expectations. 
• Instructing wet laboratory techniques 
• Accustomed to (and/or currently performing) assorted laboratory techniques including:
          ▸ Purifying compounds through chromatography, distillation, and gravimetric procedures for 
             quantitative measurements
          ▸ Employing mass spectrometry, titration, and NRS for qualitative detection of compounds
          ▸ Extracting DNA for electrophoresis analysis
          ▸ Blood typing for blood analysis
          ▸ Operating PCR for polymerase synthesis
• Self-volunteered to collaborate with the Salk Institute to provide equipment and offer instruction in lab
  techniques for title 1 secondary students.
• Undertaking efforts to secured grants for promising individuals including a (recently obtained) $140,000 scholarship

positions.title: Mathematics and Product Design instructor
positions.description:
• Instructed Integrated Mathematics and human-centric, product development course named Design Thinking.
• Lead a group of secondary students to win the Photonics Innovation Award in the global Jacobs Innovation Challenge.
• Undertook connection efforts to highlight said team to a Spotlight Community public podcast. Spoke as a guest representative in providing catalysts for secondary students to tackle local and global problems by offering entrepreneurial initiatives.
• Cooperated with a local manufacture company to provide grant for sustainability research.
